content: The International Day against Drug Abuse and Illicit Trafficking is a global observance established by the United Nations to combat drug abuse and the illegal drug trade. This day has been observed annually on June 26 since 1988. The date was specifically chosen to honor Lin Zexu's efforts in dismantling the opium trade in Humen, Guangdong, which occurred just prior to the Opium War. This historical event is also referred to as 虎门销烟 (Humen Opium Destruction). The observance was officially instituted through United Nations General Assembly resolution 42/117, adopted on December 7, 1987. According to the United Nations' 2007 World Drug Report, the global illegal drug trade was estimated to have an annual value of approximately $322 billion USD.
